description:
Public method signatures in calendar.rs:78, event.rs:87, event_notification.rs:82, participant_identity.rs:65 all take `destroy: Option<Vec<&str>>`.

The method body iterates and clones every element. There is no use of `Vec`'s growable behavior or its ownership. The signature should be `destroy: Option<&[&str]>` (or `impl IntoIterator<Item = &str>` if you want maximum generality).

Caller cost today: a caller who has `&[String]` (typical from a previous /get response's `destroyed` field) must do:
```
let v: Vec<&str> = ids.iter().map(String::as_str).collect();
calendar_set(None, None, Some(v), None).await?;
```

A `&[&str]` parameter would let them pass `&v`, and an `impl IntoIterator` would let them skip the intermediate Vec entirely. Section: ownership — the function takes ownership of a Vec it never uses as a Vec.

Also affects calendar_event_parse (event_parse.rs:15) which already takes `blob_ids: &[&str]` — the inconsistency is its own readability cost. Pick one.
title: destroy: Option<Vec<&str>> forces caller to materialize a Vec — &[&str] would do
